angle: Movement translation, defensive line (chosen by a fixed rule from a five-group screen: highest lower bound on drill-to-NFL rank correlation among groups with an individual production stat). Movement type = straight-line acceleration from a stance at 1-5 yd/s; Combine envelope from all drills (combine_frames) vs NFL envelope from the first 3 s of random sampled rushes (game_frames_sample). Tested against career pressure rate beyond pick-only, pick+role (pre-set headline), full and ridge baselines, leave-one-class-out, with a within-class shuffle placebo, OL/WR/TE negative controls and a mediation split (Combine envelope -> NFL envelope -> pressure).
metric_name: Launch Carry: median over speed bands (1-5 yd/s) of NFL-rush 90th-percentile forward acceleration divided by Combine-drill 90th-percentile forward acceleration at the same speed (1 = shows his full Combine launch on Sundays)
headline_number: Launch Carry beyond pick + role on unseen classes -0.27 pressure-rate pts/sd [-0.95, 0.43], n=69, inside the shuffle band [-0.48, 0.45] (p 0.36); against pick alone it looks like +0.55 [0.10, 0.97] because Carry tracks edge alignment (rho 0.73). DL translation 0.40 pooled falls to 0.16 [-0.02, 0.31] with weight and role fixed (ceiling 0.67). Combine launch envelope alone +0.49 [0.10, 0.89] (shuffle p 0.07, R2 change -0.031), of which 0.03 [-0.05, 0.16] (~7%) runs through the NFL launch.
what_changed_from_previous: New metric on the translation angle (round 23 cand_3 Release Match, WR, 7.74). Applies the round-23 judges' general top_changes: (1) pre-set pick + role headline baseline with positive held-out R2 (0.19) plus ridge-shrunk and full baselines, replacing the negative-R2 comparator; (2) within-class permutation placebo (1,000 shuffles) drawn in Fig 3; (3) negative controls in OL, WR, TE; (4) mediation decomposition Combine envelope -> NFL envelope -> pressure on the same 69 rushers; (5) class-stratified bootstrap with all folds refit for the R2 gain; (6) EPA filter traced with a simple stated rule (1681 snaps, 135 pressured, 0.53 EPA); (7) fixed top-third Monday rule with expected count per class, back-test and cost of a miss; (8) plain language, why-now paragraph, lede numbers once, n in every caption, no label clipping; writeup rendered from numbers.json by the script. 1,878 words, 4 figures + 2 tables.
open_risks: Headline is a null for translation; the positive Combine-envelope lean has shuffle p 0.07, a negative held-out R2 change and comes mostly from the 2024 class.
Role is a share of sampled snaps at EDGE/OLB, which also absorbs scheme; the trap result depends on it.
Combine envelope pools drills of different kinds (reliability 0.49), year- but not drill-mix-standardized.
NFL side rests on a median 20 random sampled snaps per lineman, with no blockers or ball; stunts and read-steps look like slow launches.
Named-player clips are located by tracking but not film-verified; mediation is in-sample.
Overlaps sibling cand_1 (DL Hoop G) on the same rusher pool, though on a different movement (launch, not bend); analysis.py takes about 3.5 minutes.
